questions.question:
What will be the value of the given expression if ‘A’ means ‘+’, ‘B’ means ‘–’, ‘C’ means ‘×’, and ‘D’ means ‘÷’?

36 A (15 C 4) B (21 A 13) A 24 D (16 D 2) = ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e50723751bca1df33fc1f030f78c1eac3344f2cdb432474cd432c6df783a12ab.png] 

 
 

 **Alphabets**
 A
 B
 C
 D
 
 

 **Symbols**
 +
 -
 × 
 ÷ 
 
 

Given expression : 36 A (15 C 4) B (21 A 13) A 24 D (16 D 2) = ?

After replacing the given symbols in place of alphabets the expression is as follows : 36 + (15 × 4) - (21 + 13) + 24 ÷ (16 ÷ 2)

= 36 + __**(15 × 4)**__ - __**(21 + 13)**__ + 24 ÷ __**(16 ÷ 2)**__

= 36 + 60 - 34 + __**24 ÷ 8**__

= __**36 + 60**__ - 34 __**+ 3**__

= __**99 - 34**__

=** ****65**

Hence, the correct answer is **"65".**

questions.question: The ages of two sisters Rajini and Rani are in the proportion of 2 ∶ 3. After 6 years, the proportion of their ages will be 3 ∶ 4. What is the current age of Rajini?
questions.solution:
Given,

The ages of two sisters Rajini and Rani are in the proportion of 2 ∶ 3.

Age of Rajini = 2x

Age of Rani = 3x

After 6 years, the proportion of their ages will be 3 ∶ 4

⇒ (2x + 6) : (3x + 6) = 3 : 4

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All rats are dogs.

Some rats are hens.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some rats are dogs.

II. Some hens are rats.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f587bf55502de62e0a18361ac7a83bde2789d10fbb86257b8f8dd3a03e5464c.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some rats are dogs → True (As All rats are dogs so, Some rats are dogs is True, As all rats are dogs, So some rats are dogs is definitely true)

II. Some hens are rats → True (As Some rats are hens. so, Some hens are rats is definitely true)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Both conclusions I and II follow".**

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series, will complete the series.

O _ K M _ O P K _ A O _ _ M A
questions.solution:
Given :- O _ K M _ O P K _ A O _ _ M A

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) P A M P O → O **P** K M **A** - O P K **M** A - O **P** **O** M A

2) P M A P K → O** P** K M **M** - O P K **A** A - O **P** **K** M A

3) M A K A P → O **M** K M **A** - O P K **K** A - O **A P** M A

4) P A M P K → O **P** K M **A** - O P K **M** A - O **P K **M A

 
• Here, **"OPKMA"** is repeated.
 
• Option (4) gives the pattern of :- **O** P **K M** A - O P K M A - **O** P K **M A**

Hence, the correct answer is **"P A M P K".**

= 18 + 1 + 20

= 39

= 4 + 15 + 7

= 26

Similarly,

'YAK' will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/760e082d1da35dd9f60eac571298ef7dd1cb40a8eaae268b5d3ea2cfce353610.png] 

**= 25 + 1 + 11**

**= 37**

Hence, the correct answer is **"37".**
